brief:
Cairo is considering holding parliamentary and presidential elections at the same time, according to Ma'an Wire, amid broader discussions about unifying Fatah and integrating Hamas within Palestinian governance structures. The timing proposal comes as part of efforts to reshape Palestinian institutional frameworks.

Details on the scope and timeline of these potential electoral changes remain unclear. The synchronization would represent a significant shift in how Palestinian elections have been conducted in the past.
title: Egypt mulls simultaneous legislative and presidential elections with Palestinian unity talks
